architecture: Next.js storefront/admin with NestJS API, TypeORM/PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO and Meilisearch

knownRisks: All old clones are invalid after the 2026-08-01 history rewrite and must be replaced with fresh clones
External provider tokens for SMS, payment and CRM still require owner-side rotation
Integration, concurrency and end-to-end coverage is incomplete
Local node_modules is not a trustworthy clean-install baseline
Existing minOrderQty values still mean pack counts after the 2026-08-18 semantics change and must not be bulk-rewritten without a dry-run report and owner confirm
Channel discount columns are nullable until an owner-approved backfill; legacy isDiscounted remains the fallback
Static PRODUCT_SLUG_REDIRECTS in middleware inverted live canonical slugs; lookup moved to PDP so admin slug changes win

security.secrets: Never store credentials, tokens or real environment values in repository memory or documentation
